title: Publish the provisional all-P0 independent-review package
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 6, 2026 instruction to complete the current work and continue priority research items 1 through 7, excluding the full FS3 report. Publish the all-P0 independent-review package so reviewers can inspect its evidence coverage, dependency gates, Coverage Gaps, and machine-verifiable review requirements. The package must remain provisional and Consensus-incomplete until qualifying independent reviews are submitted and the Consensus Gate is satisfied. This directive does not authorize merging a Pull Request or representing the package as independently verified.
